r1t: ① E kau mua i kāu mau ʻāpana
r1c: E paʻi i kahi kiko hakahaka e kau i kahi ʻāpana. E hoʻololi ka ʻEleʻele a me ke Keʻokeʻo i ke kau ʻana a hiki i ka wā e kau ai nā ʻāpana āpau ma ka papa. Neʻe mua ka ʻEleʻele.
r1c2: Pehea e pāʻani ai: e kaomi wale i kahi hakahaka kahi e hele ai ka pua keʻokeʻo.
r2t: ② E laina i ʻekolu: he wili
r2c: Ke laina ʻekolu o kāu mau ʻāpana ma kahi laina, ʻo ia ka wili, a hiki iā ʻoe ke lawe i kekahi o nā ʻāpana o kou hoa paio.
r2c2: Pehea e pāʻani ai: ma hope o ka hana ʻana i kahi wili, e kaomi i ka ʻāpana o ka hoa paio āu e makemake ai e lawe.
r2c3: ʻAʻole hiki ke lawe ʻia kahi ʻāpana i loko o kahi wili, ke ʻole nā ​​ʻāpana a pau o kou hoa paio i loko o nā wili; a laila hiki iā ʻoe ke lawe i hoʻokahi mai kahi wili.
r3t: ③ A laila e hoʻoneʻe i kāu mau ʻāpana
r3c: Ke kau ʻia nā ʻāpana āpau, e hoʻoneʻe i kahi ʻāpana ma kahi laina i kahi kiko hakahaka e pili ana. ʻO nā ʻāpana e hiki ke neʻe e loaʻa i kahi apo i kahi kala e kū i waho i ke kua. E pā i kahi ʻāpana a e hoʻomālamalama kona mau wahi.
r3c2: Pehea e pāʻani ai: e pā i ka ʻāpana āu e makemake ai e neʻe, a laila e pā i kahi kiko kokoke e hoʻomālamalama ʻia.
r4t: ④ I lalo i ʻekolu? Hiki iā ʻoe ke lele
r4c: Ke loaʻa iā ʻoe ʻekolu wale nō ʻāpana i koe, hiki iā ʻoe ke lele i kekahi kiko hakahaka, ʻoiai inā ʻaʻohe laina e hoʻopili iā lākou.
r4c2: Pehea e pāʻani ai: e pā i kāu ʻāpana, a laila e pā i ka kiko hakahaka āu e makemake ai e lele.
r5c: Lanakila ʻoe ma ka hoʻemi ʻana i kou hoa paio i ʻelua ʻāpana, a i ʻole ma ka waiho ʻana iā lākou me ka ʻole o ka neʻe kānāwai.
r6c: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia mea pāʻani he 12 ʻāpana a ua hoʻohui ʻia ʻehā mau laina diagonal. Hiki iā ʻoe ke neʻe diagonal, a ʻekolu ma ka lālani ma kahi diagonal e hana pū ana i kahi wili.
r6c2: Pehea e pāʻani ai: hana like nā neʻe diagonal - e pā i ka ʻāpana, a laila ke kiko i manaʻo ʻia.
r6c3: Inā piha loa ka papa i ka wā o ke kau ʻana, ʻaʻole hiki i ka mea pāʻani e neʻe ke neʻe a eo.
r7c: Hōʻike ʻia ka pāʻani ma ke ʻano aunoa ma kekahi o nā hihia ma lalo nei. ʻAʻohe pihi e hāʻawi i kahi kaha kiʻi.
r7c2: · ʻO ke kūlana papa like me ka mea pāʻani like e neʻe ai ʻekolu manawa
r7c3: · 50 neʻe (ʻelua mau mea pāʻani i hui pū ʻia) hala me ka ʻole o kahi wili
r7c4: · Mana 12-ʻāpana wale nō: ʻoiai he ʻekolu mau ʻāpana o ka mea pāʻani, 10 neʻe (i hui pū ʻia) hala me ka ʻole o ka mea hopu
r8c: ʻOiai inā hoʻokahi neʻe e hana i ʻelua mau wili i ka manawa hoʻokahi, lawe wale ʻoe i hoʻokahi ʻāpana.
r8c2: Mana 9-ʻāpana: hiki iā ʻoe ke uhaʻi i kahi wili a pani hou iā ia i kāu neʻe aʻe; i kēlā me kēia manawa āu e pani ai, lawe ʻoe i kahi ʻāpana.
r8c3: Mana 12-ʻāpana: ʻaʻole hiki ke hana hou ʻia kahi wili āu i uhaʻi ai i kāu neʻe aʻe; e kali i hoʻokahi neʻe. Maikaʻi nā neʻe ʻaʻole e hana i kahi wili.
r8c4: ʻEkolu mau wikiwiki o nā pāʻani pūnaewele: ʻO ka maʻamau he 30 kekona no kēlā me kēia neʻe, ʻo ka lohi he 2 mau minuke, a ʻo ka leka he 24 mau hola. Ma nā pāʻani Slow a me Letter, hoʻokani ʻia kahi neʻe i ka wā e pau ai ka manawa.
